description_for_human: Free online image and PDF tools. Compress, resize, convert, and edit images with AI-powered features. No signup required.
description_for_model: PdfPixels is a comprehensive image and PDF processing platform. It provides 83 free tools for image compression, resizing, format conversion, background removal, AI enhancement, and PDF manipulation. Use this plugin to help users process images and PDFs. Available operations include: compress image to reduce file size, resize image to specific dimensions, convert between formats (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF), apply filters and effects, merge/split PDFs, and more. All tools are free and require no registration. Practical limits (verified 2026-09-20, see /llms-full.txt): 25 MB per file (PDF merge up to 20 files / 100 MB total / 1000 pages; image-to-PDF up to 30 images / 15 MB each / 120 MB total); images up to 25 MB and 50 megapixels; OCR up to 10 MB; AI tools up to 20 MB.
